01 — Profile

Where streaming data meets strategy.

I spent 3+ years in music streaming and entertainment — at Saregama India, one of the world's largest catalogs of Indian music, and at Rayappan Productions, where I ran royalty operations and distribution analytics for independent artists.

That work put me close to the data behind hits: streaming velocity, DSP performance, demographic reach. Along the way, six of the tracks I worked on landed on Spotify's Local Pulse Chennai charts — including a release that became the chart's biggest weekly gainer.

Now finishing my MBA in Business Analytics, I pair that domain instinct with Python, SQL, and machine learning — most recently co-authoring an IEEE FinTech paper on financial inclusion built on 189,000+ transaction records.
